paragraphs.text: Tentacle is a token -only creature type originally introduced in Theros Beyond Death . It is used for cards that depict flexible limbs or appendages from a Kraken . Tentacles are used for grasping or moving about.

A tentacle is not really a species or job. The type fulfills the same function as the non-legal type Head that appeared in the Face the Hydra Challenge Deck from the Theros block . The latter was always combined with the creature type Hydra .
The Nadir Kraken has massive tentacles, tens of times larger than a ship that fight independently of the main body.
The Watcher in the Water is a mysterious creature that lurks below water and surfaces numerious tentacles that attempt to fight and pull creatures under the water.
